annotations.title: Who plays what: population by race, class, faction and level

description: Counts observed Forever characters by race, class, faction and level band from opt-in addon census uploads, not the whole realm population. Each character counts once. Normally counts need 10 characters, 3 installs and 3 addresses, rounded to 5, with inferable small counts hidden. While few players upload, Everloot's own installs also count on their own, though the 10-character minimum still applies; preserve that label because counts can come from one player's game. The window is active in 7 days by default, or since launch. No names. Missing census data is unrecorded, not zero. Use class_races for which races can be a class; use this tool for observed counts.

class.description: A class, such as Priest. Without it, every class.

faction.description: Alliance or Horde. Without it, both.

race.description: A race, such as Gnome, Night Elf or Undead. Without it, every race.

window.description: week (default): active in the last 7 days. launch: seen since launch.

name: population

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

count.description: Characters, rounded to the nearest 5. Null is hidden: fewer than 10 characters, fewer than 3 installs or fewer than 3 addresses, or hidden so a small count can't be worked out from the others.

race.description: UnitRace's token, such as Scourge for Undead.

share.description: count out of the window's characters, both as shown.

collecting.description: True until the window has 10 characters from 3 installs and 3 addresses; no count shows until then.

installs.description: Installs that reported in the window: a count of installs, not of people.

launched.description: False before launch: nothing is counted yet.

note.description: Why there are no cells: a name the game does not have, or a combination it does not allow.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.
